 Mr. Vikas Kumar ,Adv  For the State : Mr. Shailendra Kr. Sinha ,Addl. PP.
03 / 06.10.2025 I.A. No. 10456 of 2023 Heard the parties.
Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that this interlocutory application has become infructuous.
In view of the aforesaid submission, this interlocutory application stands disposed of being infructuous.
(ANIL KUMAR CHOUDHARY, J.)

Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that this interlocutory application has been filed with a prayer to amend this criminal miscellaneous petition by incorporating the additional prayer of quashing the order of framing of charge against the petitioner for having committed the offence punishable under Section 376(2) (n) of IPC and Section 6 of the POCSO Act, vide order dated 18.01.2024 by the learned trial court, in paragraph 1 and prayer portion of this criminal miscellaneous petition.

It is next submitted that the amendment was necessitated because of development which took place after filing of this criminal miscellaneous petition and the additional prayer will not change the nature and character of this criminal miscellaneous petition and unless the proposed amendment is allowed, the petitioner will be highly prejudiced.
